dialogue: Ok, so you know how to slide boost right? Like sliding and jumping?
Have you ever noticed how it feels like you slow down when you touch the ground?
That's because the ground got lots of friction!
So to keep your speed is to hop on the ground after a slide boost!
It'll help you keep nyooming faster!
If you want some more movement tips, check back in with me!
I got loads more where that came from!
